question.text: Which of the following statements is not true about RNA?

options.text: It controls the synthesis of protein
It has always double standard <math><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi><mo>-</mo></math> helix structure
It is present in the nucleus of the cell

solution.text: RNA is a single Helix structure in which hydrogen bonding are not present between nitrogen base and is made of ribonucleotides that are linked by phosphodiester bonds.
